title: Phoenix Volcano
summary: Phoenix Volcano is a large volcano located on an uninhabited Indonesian island. It was the resting place of the Ring of Phoenix, the Legendary Titan of Rebirth, and was protected by an anti-magic field generated by the Lodestone. sections.heading: History
sections.text:
The Blood Spiral travelled into the centre of the volcano and began searching for the Ring using ceramic rods. The Huntik team, however, managed to destroy the Lodestone, disabling the anti-magic field surrounding the area and enabling them to use their powers. [The Dead Magic Island]

The Huntik team entered the volcano through a lava tube, and, after launching a surprise attack on Wind and Shauna, the team deduced that the Amulet would be in the leftmost pit, as the leftmost gem on the Amulet of Will was red. After a huge battle, Sophie Casterwill dived into the pit, overcoming her fear of the fire. The volcano subsequently erupted, forcing the others to flee. Sophie then emerged from the volcano with Phoenix, reborn from the ashes. [The Phoenix's Ashes]
